author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam finishes his build of the Green Destiny sword from Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon! After the final sword assembly, it's time to build an ornate carrying case for this replica. And that's the perfect opportunity for Adam to stress test his new ultrasonic cutter to carve all the details into this box!

Adam's Crouching Tiger Green Destiny Sword build: 
Part 1: https://youtu.be/i7MtPEPD_YY
Part 2: https://youtu.be/K7BanzKNuk0
Part 3: https://youtu.be/QzVSY2p5V7Q
Another great replica build of this sword by Man at Arms: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ObYP1jTJ9MM
Nakanishi sonic cutter: https://en.nakanishi-spindle.com/mgt/soniccutter-zero/

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Josh Self
Music by Jinglepunks
